body.en: Gazette entries in the NCCU official-post database show that Chen Shaokuan was appointed commander of the Navy's Second Fleet on 18 September 1926. On 12 April 1929 he became political vice-minister of the Navy and acted as Navy minister until Yang Shuzhuang took up the post. He was specially appointed Navy minister on 30 December 1931, became a first-class admiral on 6 September 1935, and was specially appointed Navy minister again on 12 December 1935.

heading.zh-Hant: 八一三與江陰封江自沉

body.zh-Hant: 據國防部《海軍軍官》刊載的馬煥棟文章，1937年8月13日淞滬戰事爆發後，海軍部部長陳紹寬上將親率艦隊赴江陰指揮，將老舊艦艇12艘、徵招商輪23艘、躉船8艘自沉於江陰航道，形成封鎖線，是為江陰戰役的開端部署。王鏡宇的文章記載，會議議決在8月12日執行封江，陳紹寬在「平海」艦上發出沉船命令，該艦並升起他的上將司令旗。
body.en: According to Ma Huandong's article in the Ministry of National Defense's Naval Officer, after fighting at Shanghai broke out on 13 August 1937 Navy minister Admiral Chen Shaokuan personally led the fleet to Jiangyin, where 12 old warships, 23 requisitioned merchant ships and 8 hulks were scuttled in the channel to form a blockade line. Wang Jingyu's article says the meeting decided to carry out the river blockade on 12 August, and that Chen gave the order to scuttle from the Pinghai, which flew his admiral's flag.

body.zh-Hant: 王宏松的國史館館刊文章記載，閩變期間海軍部長陳紹寬曾電蔣中正報告閩綏靖署委黃強等事，《大公報》也報導海長陳紹寬將出發前方。林桶法的文章則記載，蔣中正於8月20日條諭江陰區江防司令歐陽格，令歸海軍陳紹寬統一指揮。
body.en: In Wang Hongsong's article in the Academia Historica journal, Navy minister Chen Shaokuan telegraphed Chiang Kai-shek during the Fujian Rebellion about the Fujian pacification office's appointment of Huang Qiang, and the Ta Kung Pao reported that the Navy minister Chen Shaokuan would go to the front. Lin Tongfa's article records that on 20 August Chiang Kai-shek ordered the Jiangyin river-defence commander Ouyang Ge to come under the unified command of the Navy's Chen Shaokuan.

heading.en: The Eleventh Army in the Northern Expedition

body.zh-Hant: 據 Boorman《民國人物傳記辭典》，北伐初期陳銘樞與白崇禧被派往湖南說服唐生智。1926年8月，陳銘樞的第四軍第十師與張發奎的第十二師在汀泗橋戰役中擊敗吳佩孚部而名聞全國；同年10月，他指揮的部隊攻克武昌。其後第十師擴編為第十一軍，由陳銘樞任軍長。
body.en: According to Boorman's Biographical Dictionary of Republican China, at the start of the Northern Expedition Chen Mingshu and Bai Chongxi were sent to Hunan to win over Tang Shengzhi. In August 1926 Chen's 10th Division of the Fourth Army and Zhang Fakui's 12th Division won nationwide attention in the battle at Dingsiqiao, a Nationalist victory over Wu Peifu's forces, and in October his forces captured Wuchang. The 10th Division was then enlarged into the Eleventh Army with Chen as commander.

body.zh-Hant: 1931年11月，陳銘樞被任命為上海地區衛戍司令；12月新政府成立，他任行政院副院長兼交通部長。1932年1月，第十九路軍在上海頑強抗擊日軍而獲國際關注，陳銘樞因是這支部隊的總負責人而分享榮耀，但直接指揮作戰的是蔣光鼐、蔡廷鍇等人。

heading.en: The Fukien revolt and the war years

body.zh-Hant: 1933年11月20日，福建事變爆發，翌日福州成立人民政府；Boorman 稱李濟深僅是名義上的主席，陳銘樞才是主要組織者與政策籌劃者。福州政權於1934年1月中旬瓦解，陳銘樞逃往香港。1937年抗戰爆發後他返回大陸，但因福建事變中的角色，整個戰爭期間未獲實質任命。
body.en: The Fukien revolt against Nanjing was launched on 20 November 1933 and a people's government was set up at Foochow the next day. Boorman says Li Jishen was essentially a figurehead and Chen Mingshu the key organizer and policy planner. The Foochow regime disintegrated in mid-January 1934 and Chen fled to Hong Kong. He returned after the Sino-Japanese war broke out in 1937 but, because of his role in the Fukien revolt, was never given a substantive assignment during the war.

heading.en: The Fujian Rebellion and expulsion from the Party

body.zh-Hant: 王宏松的國史館館刊文章記載，陳銘樞於1932年6月底辭去交通部長和軍事委員會本兼各職。11月20日，他結合李濟深發動以蔣光鼐、蔡廷鍇所統率的第十九路軍為軍事資本的閩變，並兼任文化委員會主席；國民黨中常會隨後決議，將陳銘樞等人永遠開除黨籍。
body.en: Wang Hongsong's article in the Academia Historica journal records that at the end of June 1932 Chen Mingshu resigned as Minister of Communications and from his posts on the Military Affairs Commission. On 20 November he joined Li Jishen in launching the Fujian Rebellion with the 19th Route Army, commanded by Jiang Guangnai and Cai Tingkai, as its military capital, and he also served as chairman of the Culture Committee; the KMT Standing Committee then resolved to expel Chen Mingshu and others from the Party permanently.

heading.en: The 1930 war and the Guards Army

body.zh-Hant: 據 Boorman《民國人物傳記辭典》，顧祝同1929年10月任第一軍軍長；1930年他率軍對抗馮玉祥、閻錫山的北方聯盟，自5月底到9月在河南戰線苦戰。1931年7月，他被任為南京國民政府警衛軍軍長，隨後率第二集團軍入河北，輕易平定石友三的叛變。
body.en: According to Boorman's Biographical Dictionary of Republican China, Gu Zhutong became commander of the First Army in October 1929. In 1930 he led his army against the northern coalition of Feng Yuxiang and Yan Xishan, fighting a hard campaign on the Henan front from the end of May until September. In July 1931 he was appointed commander of the National Government Guards Army at Nanjing and soon led the Second Group Army into Hebei, easily quelling Shi Yousan's revolt.

body.en: Boorman records that after the war began Gu was appointed commander in chief of the Ninth Group Army; on the Shanghai front the Chinese resisted until 5 November, when the Japanese outflanked them with a landing in Hangzhou Bay. After the evacuation of Nanjing on 12 December 1937 he was designated commander of the Third War Area and held it for the rest of the war. In January 1941 New Fourth Army units and Nationalist troops clashed at Maolin in southern Anhui; the battle of 6–14 January ended with Xiang Ying killed and Ye Ting captured. In autumn 1945 he accepted the Japanese surrender in the Third War Area.

heading.zh-Hant: 內戰與陸軍總司令、參謀總長
heading.en: Army commander-in-chief and chief of the general staff

body.zh-Hant: Boorman 記載，1946年1月戰區機構撤銷後，顧祝同任徐州綏靖主任；5月18日起任陸軍總司令，1947年在山東發動攻勢，收復該省大部。1948年5月他任國防部參謀總長，1949年4月22日南京陷落後飛往上海，恢復陸軍總司令一職。同年12月他在西南指揮作戰，12月25日離開四川飛往海南島。
body.en: Boorman records that after the war-area administrations were abolished in January 1946 Gu became pacification commissioner at Xuzhou; from 18 May he was commander in chief of the army, and in 1947 he mounted a campaign in Shandong that restored much of the province to Nationalist control. In May 1948 he became chief of the general staff in the Ministry of National Defense. After Nanjing fell on 22 April 1949 he flew to Shanghai and resumed command of the army, directed operations in the southwest in December 1949, and on 25 December flew from Sichuan to Hainan.

body.zh-Hant: 林桶法的文章記載，1937年8月15日顧祝同接受副司令長官後，蔣中正指導戰事的意志力更強；戰區代理司令長官顧祝同並讓精銳的第八十八師單獨留守。防衛研究所藤井元博的論文則記載，第3戰區的顧祝同司令官透過部隊的政治教育與支援遊擊戰的宣傳，經營與住民的關係。
body.en: Lin Tongfa's article records that after Gu Zhutong accepted the post of deputy commander on 15 August 1937, Chiang Kai-shek's will to direct the war grew stronger, and that Acting Commander Gu Zhutong left the elite 88th Division to hold on its own. A study by Fujii Motohiro of Japan's National Institute for Defense Studies records that the Third War Zone commander Gu Zhutong worked through political education of the troops and propaganda in support of guerrilla warfare.

body.zh-Hant: 據 Boorman《民國人物傳記辭典》，馬步芳1920年進入寧海軍任副營長，1930年底升任暫編第一師師長，受顧祝同委派為青海南部警備司令，奉命進攻謀求在甘肅建立獨立基地的馬仲英，把他擊潰並趕往西邊。1932年他與劉文輝合作處理甘孜衝突，7月部隊抵達金沙江，其後他談定青藏和約，1933年7月送交國民政府核准。
body.en: According to Boorman's Biographical Dictionary of Republican China, Ma Bufang joined the Ninghai Army in 1920 as a deputy battalion commander and by the end of 1930 commanded the Provisional 1st Division. Gu Zhutong made him garrison commander for southern Qinghai and ordered him to march on Ma Zhongying, who sought an independent base in Gansu, and Ma Bufang drove him westward and scattered his forces. In 1932 he cooperated with Liu Wenhui over the Kantzu conflict, his forces reached the Jinsha River by July, and he negotiated a Qinghai-Tibetan peace treaty submitted for approval in July 1933.

body.zh-Hant: Boorman 記載，馬麟為1931至1938年青海政府的名義首長，馬步芳則任代理主席兼第八十二師師長，1938年才被確認為主席。抗戰期間他推行包括保甲制、整訓軍備、禁煙等「六大任務」；1943年他被任為第四十集團軍總司令，兩年後任蔣中正西北行營副主任並為國民黨中央執行委員。
body.en: Boorman records that Ma Lin was titular head of the Qinghai government from 1931 to 1938 while Ma Bufang was acting governor and commander of the 82nd Division, and Ma was confirmed as governor in 1938. During the war he undertook what he called the Six Great Tasks, including the pao-chia system, a military reserve and the ban on opium. In 1943 he was appointed commander in chief of the Fortieth Group Army, and two years later he became a deputy chairman of Chiang Kai-shek's northwest headquarters and a member of the Kuomintang Central Executive Committee.

body.zh-Hant: 鄭國良的政大碩士論文記載，1935年6月中共紅軍由四川北竄，青馬奉中央命令在青海南部作戰；中央為獎勵青馬反共有功，將陸軍新編第二軍改編為陸軍第八十二軍，馬步芳任軍長。1943年2月23日，馬步芳以黨、政、軍工作繁鉅為由，希望擔任八十二軍副軍長的獨子馬繼援升為軍長；後來馬步青與馬步芳兩軍合併為第四十集團軍。
body.en: Zheng Guoliang's master's thesis at National Chengchi University records that in June 1935, when the Red Army moved north from Sichuan, the Ma forces fought in southern Qinghai on the Centre's orders; to reward the Ma family's anti-communist service, the Centre reorganised the New 2nd Army into the 82nd Army, with Ma Bufang as its commander. On 23 February 1943 Ma Bufang, citing the weight of his Party, government and military work, asked that his only son Ma Jiyuan, deputy commander of the 82nd Army, be promoted to commander; the forces of Ma Buqing and Ma Bufang were later merged into the 40th Army Group.
